theme: A quiet day; tomorrow does the work.
greeting: A light Wednesday behind you, Dan — one Teams call and an otherwise open day. Tomorrow bunches up around midday, so tonight's a good one to keep easy.

needsAttention.title: NACD New England prep session
needsAttention.detail: Tomorrow at 1 PM on Zoom — the chapter's prep call for its Oct 28 event, and Larissa sent the draft discussion questions. Skim them tonight so the hour runs on your terms.

needsAttention.title: Confirm the Oct 15 intro call
needsAttention.detail: Amin Noorani — the Jo Notkin introduction — has your CV and proposed Teams on Thursday Oct 15 at 9:30 AM. A one-line yes holds the slot.

needsAttention.title: December trip — book by Oct 15
needsAttention.detail: The decision was due Sept 30 and the book-by is a week out. Holiday inventory for six over three weeks is the thinnest of the year — pick the domestic default or commit to refundable-international, not both.

needsAttention.title: Maine Christmas SUV rental
needsAttention.detail: The Pathfinder heads south this month, so there's no six-seater in Maine at Christmas. A refundable full-size SUV out of Portland costs nothing to hold now and sells out if you wait.

needsAttention.title: Drive the Pathfinder south
needsAttention.detail: The Oct 5–18 Maine gap is the window to drive Portland → St Pete. Doing it in-window is what retires the Oct 18 rental and the monthly cycles after it.

flagged.title: Intro to Sun Life's sustainability lead
flagged.detail: Pema Lhalungpa connected you with Marissa Glassbrook at Sun Life on Monday — still waiting on your note back.
